## B. Consolidation checklist

Use this checklist while revising:

1. Revisit your weakest topics from Weeks 1 to 11.
2. Re-run seminar code for at least two ARIMA weeks and one regression week.
3. Re-check diagnostics workflow: identify, estimate, diagnose, forecast, justify.
4. Review assignment feedback and note recurring mistakes.
